mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy (name, description, dsl, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{dsl}, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime')) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET description = excluded.description, dsl = excluded.dsl, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, dsl FROM strategy ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
